name: jev-tools
description: Small typed decisions from OpenJev (Codiv System One) for Claude Code: a rule-enforcing edit hook, a skill-pick hook, and skills for file discovery, browser navigation, review pre-checks and rule calibration. Ships in shadow mode: hooks log what they would do and never block or inject until you switch to active.

api_key.title: OpenJev (Codiv) API key
api_key.description: Key for api.codiv.ai (starts with sk-codiv-). Optional here: the OPENJEV_API_KEY environment variable also works and takes precedence. With no key anywhere every hook does nothing.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow (default): hooks only log to the decision log. active: the rule hook blocks edits Jev confirms break a project rule, and the skill hook injects its pick. off: hooks do nothing. The JEV_MODE environment variable overrides this.
